about: Draws the palette a person opens with a keystroke, types into, and runs one thing from.

empty.about: A palette holding a query nothing matches. The message takes the place of the rows, and the control at the end of the bar empties the query and returns the reader to the field. Both are drawn only once there is something to clear, so neither can be read off a palette nobody has typed into.
empty.title: Nothing matches

size.about: Every size. The size reaches the rows as well as the bar, so a small palette is a small list rather than a short bar over rows of the usual height. Type into a field to narrow the list, and move down it with the arrows.
size.title: Sizes
